evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Tube pressure was 3.006 Torr during growth.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.196 Torr at unchanged argon setpoint; without pressure limits or reference data this does not identify a fault.
Temperature 750.4 C and argon flow 99.8 sccm closely match setpoints of 750 C and 100 sccm; heater power is stable at 44.4%.

args.missing_evidence: Required exhaust O2 measurement to verify atmosphere; expected growth-pressure range and a pressure-trend check to establish whether the rise is abnormal; sample characterization to determine growth outcome.
